path_frame S7 class

path_frame-class.Rd

path_frame is an S7 class to standardize the various ways in which paths that can be specified across the multifactor package. This class is mostly for internal use.

Usage

path_frame(x, call = character())

Arguments

x

data.frame with the first two columns named "from" and "to". Optionally, additional columns (see Details)

call

character (Default: empty). If Input is a formula, captures the literal content as a character string. Optionally,

Value

a path_frame object.

Details

Rows represent edges in a path. Additional (optional) columns contain information about the edges:

  • components integer. Indicates subpath ID.

  • stack logical. Whether the vertex contains merged data types.

  • coverage numeric. The proportional coverage threshold (or 0).

Examples

path_frame
#> <multifactor::path_frame> class
#> @ parent     : S3<data.frame>
#> @ constructor: function(x, call) {...}
#> @ validator  : function(self) {...}
#> @ properties :
#>  $ call: <character>
